description: Website safety check for one URL. Passively fetches the site and returns a verdict (safe, caution, unsafe), a 0-100 score, and evidence-backed flags: TLS validity, HTTP-to-HTTPS redirect, redirect chain and offsite redirects, security headers, mixed content, insecure forms, and domain age from the official registry. Useful before visiting, linking to, buying from, or submitting data to an unfamiliar site. Not charged if the host cannot be checked. Paid via x402; see list_prices.
name: check_site_safety
title: Website safety check
